videos.title: ACME Solar arm signs power purchase agreement with NTPC for 150 MW hybrid project
videos.hook: ACME Solar signs *150 MW* deal with NTPC

beats.say: A subsidiary of ACME Solar has signed a power purchase agreement with NTPC for 150 megawatts.

beats.title: Signed by *ACME Alpha*
beats.say: Business Standard reports the agreement was executed by ACME Alpha Renewables, the company's subsidiary.

beats.title: A *hybrid* project
beats.say: The contract covers a hybrid power project, with the capacity set at 150 megawatts.

scene.text: PPA executed with NTPC for a hybrid power project

videos.description: ACME Solar's subsidiary, ACME Alpha Renewables, has executed a power purchase agreement with NTPC for a hybrid power project with a contract capacity of 150 MW, as reported by Business Standard.
videos.caption: ACME Solar's subsidiary ACME Alpha Renewables has executed a power purchase agreement with NTPC for a 150 MW hybrid project (Business Standard).

videos.title: SEBI chair: no decision yet on margin trading changes; longer market hours unlikely

beats.say: SEBI says it has not yet decided on proposals to revamp the Margin Trading Facility framework.

scene.text: No decision yet on revamping the Margin Trading Facility framework

beats.title: Longer hours *unlikely*
beats.say: Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey also said extending market hours looks unlikely for now.

beats.title: The *cyber* hurdle
beats.say: NDTV Profit reports he named cybersecurity risks as the hurdle to longer trading hours.

scene.text: Cybersecurity risks cited as a hurdle to extending trading hours

videos.description: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said the regulator has not decided on proposals to revamp the Margin Trading Facility framework, and cited cybersecurity risks as a hurdle to extending market hours, as reported by NDTV Profit.
videos.caption: SEBI chief says no decision yet on Margin Trading Facility changes, and cybersecurity risks stand in the way of longer market hours (NDTV Profit).

videos.title: Karnataka Bank appoints Udaya Kumar Hebbar as MD & CEO for three years

beats.say: Karnataka Bank has appointed Udaya Kumar Hebbar as its managing director and CEO for three years.

scene.text: Karnataka Bank appoints Udaya Kumar Hebbar as MD & CEO

beats.title: Ex-*CreditAccess Grameen* chief
beats.say: Business Standard says he is the former head of CreditAccess Grameen.

beats.title: RBI *approval* received
beats.say: The appointment already has RBI approval, and it still needs shareholders' approval.

videos.description: Karnataka Bank has appointed Udaya Kumar Hebbar, former CreditAccess Grameen chief, as MD & CEO for three years. The appointment has RBI approval and is subject to shareholders' approval, as reported by Business Standard.
videos.caption: Karnataka Bank appoints Udaya Kumar Hebbar as MD & CEO for three years; RBI approval received, shareholders' approval pending (Business Standard).
